subject: Mathematics
title: Binomial Theorem
summary: Positive integer n ke liye (x + a)ⁿ = Σ C(n, r) xⁿ⁻ʳ aʳ, n + 1 terms ke saath. General term Tᵣ₊₁ = C(n, r) xⁿ⁻ʳ aʳ lagbhag har sawal ki chaabi hai.
Typical sawal: koi khaas term ya coefficient, x se independent term, middle term(s), greatest coefficient, aur binomial coefficients ke sums.

Binomial coefficients Pascal's triangle follow karte hain; unka sum 2ⁿ hai, aur alternate coefficients ka sum har ek 2ⁿ⁻¹. Badi powers ka remainder base ko divisor ke multiple ke paas likh kar nikaalte hain.

formulas.name: General term
formulas.mistake: Ye (r + 1)th term hai, rth nahi — galat mat lena.

formulas.name: Middle term
formulas.formula: n even: one middle term T(n/2 + 1);  n odd: two middle terms T((n + 1)/2) and T((n + 3)/2)

formulas.name: Term independent of x
formulas.formula: set the power of x in Tᵣ₊₁ equal to 0 and solve for r

formulas.name: Sum of coefficients
formulas.formula: put x = 1 (and every other variable 1) in the expansion

formulas.name: Binomial coefficient sums
formulas.formula: C₀ + C₁ + … + Cₙ = 2ⁿ;  C₀ + C₂ + … = C₁ + C₃ + … = 2ⁿ⁻¹;  C₀ − C₁ + C₂ − … = 0

formulas.name: Pascal's rule
formulas.formula: C(n, r) + C(n, r − 1) = C(n + 1, r);  C(n, r) = C(n, n − r)

formulas.name: Hockey-stick identity
formulas.when: Kai powers k par same coefficient C(k, r) ka sum — jaise (1 + x)ʳ + (1 + x)ʳ⁺¹ + … + (1 + x)ⁿ mein xʳ ka coefficient.
formulas.mistake: Pascal's rule baar-baar lagane se aata hai. k < r wale terms 0 dete hain — unhe sum mein mat gino.

formulas.name: Greatest coefficient
formulas.formula: n even: C(n, n/2);  n odd: C(n, (n − 1)/2) = C(n, (n + 1)/2)

formulas.name: Weighted sum
formulas.when: r se multiply wale sums ((1 + x)ⁿ ko differentiate karo).

formulas.name: Coefficient in Σ k(1 + x)ᵏ
formulas.when: (1 + x) + 2(1 + x)² + … + n(1 + x)ⁿ mein xʳ ka coefficient.
formulas.mistake: Doosra tareeka: series ko AGP maan kar closed form mein sum karo, phir coefficient padho. Sirf n·C(n, r) mat likh dena.

formulas.name: Number of terms
formulas.formula: (x + a)ⁿ: n + 1 terms;  (x + y + z)ⁿ: C(n + 2, 2) terms

examples.title: x se independent term
examples.problem: (x² + 1/x)⁹ mein x se independent term nikalo.

examples.title: Remainder
examples.problem: 2¹⁰⁰ ko 7 se divide karne par remainder?

examples.title: Weighted hockey-stick
examples.problem: (1 + x) + 2(1 + x)² + 3(1 + x)³ + 4(1 + x)⁴ mein x² ka coefficient?
examples.solution: Chahiye Σ k·C(k, 2), k = 2 se 4. Todo k·C(k, 2) = 2C(k, 2) + 3C(k, 3), phir hockey-stick: 2C(5, 3) + 3C(5, 4) = 20 + 15 = 35. Seedha check: 2·1 + 3·3 + 4·6 = 35.

topics.title: Pascal's triangle
topics.explain: Har entry upar ki do entries ka sum hai; row n, (x + a)ⁿ ke coefficients deti hai. Triangle symmetric hai kyunki C(n, r) = C(n, n − r).

topics.title: Expansions with negative signs
topics.explain: (x − a)ⁿ = Σ (−1)ʳ C(n, r) xⁿ⁻ʳ aʳ — signs baari-baari badalte hain. (x + a)ⁿ + (x − a)ⁿ mein sirf odd-numbered terms bachte hain (a ki even powers); difference mein baaki.

topics.title: Divisibility and remainders
topics.explain: 9ⁿ − 8n − 1 ko 64 se divisible dikhaane ke liye 9ⁿ = (1 + 8)ⁿ likh kar expand karo: pehle do terms cancel hote hain aur baaki sab mein 8² hai. Remainders ke liye base ko (divisor ka multiple ± 1) likho.

topics.title: Numerically greatest term
topics.explain: Wo term dhoondho jahan ratio Tᵣ₊₁/Tᵣ = ((n − r + 1)/r)|a/x| pehli baar 1 se neeche jaata hai — wahi numerically greatest hai.

topics.title: Approximation
topics.explain: Chhote x ke liye (1 + x)ⁿ ≈ 1 + nx. Jaise (1.02)⁸ ≈ 1 + 8 × 0.02 = 1.16 (asli 1.1717).

topics.title: Coefficient tricks
topics.explain: (1 + x)ᵐ(1 + x)ⁿ jaise product mein xᵏ ke coefficient ke liye C(m + n, k) use karo, ya general terms multiply karke matching powers par sum karo.

ratta: n + 1 terms;  middle T(n/2 + 1) for even n.
ΣC² = C(2n, n);  Σ rC(n, r) = n2ⁿ⁻¹.
Hockey-stick: C(r, r) + C(r + 1, r) + … + C(n, r) = C(n + 1, r + 1).
